name: CustomerAccountCodeConflictReview
purpose: Bind shared-claim/reassignment acceptance to the exact current Customer Account Code conflict the operator reviewed, so an opaque review identifier or stale UI cannot authorize a different correction.

steps: validate and normalize complete code under UNICODE_MATCH_V1
load every active claimant for the normalized code in immutable customer_org_id order
load target Customer revision and its current active account-code claim if any
for reassignment also load source Customer revision and prove its current claim for the reviewed code

build canonical REVIEW_ACCOUNT_CODE_V1 document containing matching_profile_id, normalized code key, proposed_action, target Customer ID/revision/current-code-key-or-null, optional source Customer ID/revision, and complete sorted claimant Customer IDs plus their revisions
serialize with the packet's fixed canonical field order/UTF-8 encoding and compute SHA-256 review_snapshot_hash
return bounded display details plus the hash; claimant detail may paginate for display, but the hash is over the complete claimant set
preview.rule: The hash is freshness/binding evidence, not authentication or a substitute for authenticated session + anti-forgery + explicit operator confirmation.

commit_validation.transaction: inside the same LLD-01 UnitOfWork before command_receipt/domain mutation
steps: recompute REVIEW_ACCOUNT_CODE_V1 from authoritative current state using bounded indexed queries
constant-time compare recomputed SHA-256 text to supplied review_snapshot_hash
if different return REVIEW_CONTEXT_STALE with no receipt/mutation
run command-specific invariants (shared claim still has a different claimant; reassignment source still owns the code; targets remain active)
only then allow the owning command to insert its receipt and perform the reviewed mutation
commit_validation.performance: claimant set is expected small but is not product-capped; compute the hash by streaming claimant IDs/revisions in index order without materializing unbounded display objects.

audit: Successful reviewed correction records proposed_action, review_snapshot_hash, review_context_id when one exists, normalized-code evidence subject to audit payload policy, and affected immutable Customer/identifier identities. It does not claim cryptographic publisher authenticity or external-source truth.
security: client cannot choose claimant membership independently of the server-derived snapshot
review_context_id is correlation/provenance only and never sufficient authorization by itself
stale UI, replay against changed claimant state, or target-code changes fail before receipt/mutation
raw review narrative is not accepted through this algorithm; reason_category remains closed/bounded and source proposal evidence stays with its owning reconciliation domain
